steps.semantics: New producers send nonempty steps with stable unique id, label, string intent, unique-string tags, contiguous nonempty command_ordinals partitioning commands, patch and optional declared reads. request.merge: fields | atomic; default fields. doc.patch with omitted request reads is conservatively effective atomic over complete touched scopes, even with step reads or requested fields.
request.reads: Optional declared request reads: field exact tagged state, collection membership/order, or scope. Batch-entry reads and sequential steps[].reads have distinct boundaries. Explicit reads=[] is different from omission; never fabricate it from a byte diff.
request.dry_run: Optional boolean, default false; preview uses true and a separate key.

idempotency.transport: Stable HTTP Idempotency-Key required for mutation; inventory of contract transport, not an HTTP observation.

idempotency.exact_retry: First durable acceptance wins. Same request/key after lost ACK or restart returns identical {data, receipt}, without re-execution or extra history. Changed body or principal under the same key is idempotency_mismatch (409). Unknown outcome/not_ready retries the exact request/key first.
idempotency.retries: Head-CAS rebase retains original request/key (at most three attempts). Function conflict rerun uses returned head, at most three evaluations by default, with a fresh key for each changed request. Never rerun a function on unknown outcome.
idempotency.preview: No durable idempotency winner; repeated preview may evaluate a newer head. Commit after preview uses a new key and dry_run=false.

accepted_or_merged.envelope: {data, receipt}; durable non-null authentic receipt is acceptance authority; receipt.result equals accepted data.
accepted_or_merged.head_revision: accepted lands on requested base with rebased_onto=null; merged previous_* and rebased_onto pin actual landing head. Result publication ID is receipt.receipt_id; revision is accepted_revision_id.
accepted_or_merged.digests: document_digest plus closure revision content_digest values; authenticated records digest/request hash/event-chain verification retained. Merged canonical closure includes peer changes and is adopted whole.

accepted_or_merged.history_undo_steps: Receipt-bound history retains label, steps, source/rationale/group_id when supplied, merge/merge_mode, reads, exact previous/current publication/revision, provider/compiler versions, full command recorder, records.undo_of and records.undo_steps (null for whole undo). accepted_or_merged.authoritative_attribution: Runtime-authenticated publisher on result, receipt-bound history and accepted event is actor authority; source/intent/tags/label/rationale cannot override it. No client publisher/actor authority; no invented legacy attribution or step evidence.
